word_tokenize: tokenize a sentence into words using NIST tokenizer and fix special entity tokens
remove_punctuation_tokens: remove all punctuation-only tokens from a text string and return cleaned text
remove_stopwords: remove English stopwords from a text string and return the remaining words
spacy_process: process text with spaCy NLP model and return an annotated Doc object
is_punctuation: check if a single word consists entirely of punctuation characters
